text: {"lessons":["Selling some Stock B and C after substantial gains felt satisfying, but I should consider the portfolio as a whole rather than judging each stock only against its own cost.","After selling, I should keep enough invested or have a plan for the cash; gains realized in a few positions did not prevent my total account value from falling.","I rarely trade, so I should review my holdings periodically and decide in advance what would prompt action instead of simply letting losses grow unchecked."]}
